description: React component for the Home page of a silent auction platform, providing UI for creating and joining auctions, handling user input, and invoking backend services.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: React functional component rendering the home page with create and join auction forms.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new auction event, including validation, calling createEvent and sendHostMagicLink, and updating UI state.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Handles joining an existing auction by event code, validating input, and navigating to the event page.
